pages.title: Adopt a Monster
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Adopt a Monster is a merging game about growing a Halloween monster collection. Click or tap matching creatures to combine them into a new form, discovering more monsters as you continue. Complete orders and collect rewards to expand the collection.

pages.title: Snake Attack Shooter
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description:
Snake Attack Shooter pits your weapon against a giant snake that advances toward you. Aim at its segments and destroy them one by one before it reaches your position. Collect power-ups and develop weapons with higher damage and firing speed as the levels become harder.

Press the left mouse button to shoot on a computer. Touchscreen controls use touches and swipes for aiming and firing, with different modes and locations providing further battles.

pages.title: Monster Duelist
pages.creator: minix
pages.description:
Monster Duelist sends you exploring territories to capture monsters and assemble a team. Find creatures to add to your collection, then use your captured monsters in battles against opponents.

Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or the left mouse button. The left button also handles the interface as you build up your team.

pages.title: Polygon Space
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Polygon Space puts a laser cannon against attacking shapes in space. Control the turret through endless missions, select targets with a tap, and let its automatic tracking follow them during the fight. Collect resources to upgrade your weapons while trying to destroy the geometric enemies and survive their attacks.

pages.title: Snow Ball Racing Mutliplayer
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Snow Ball Racing Mutliplayer challenges you to build a snowball and send it down a slope. A larger ball travels faster and farther, so growing it before the race helps with the distance you can cover.

Longer runs earn more wins. Use those wins to open new zones and collect pets while working your way up the leaderboard.

pages.title: Solitaire Story Tripeaks 6
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Solitaire Story Tripeaks 6 takes you through card layouts with Foxy as your travel companion. Remove cards whose values are one above or below the drawn card, using the stockpile when you need another option. Clear the layout before the stock runs out.

The game includes over 6,700 levels, daily missions, and balloon and pet events. Completing missions and events unlocks deck designs and prizes, with destinations including Japan, Egypt, Brazil, and Fiji.

pages.title: Bus Jam Escape
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Bus Jam Escape asks you to sort a queue of waiting passengers by matching their colors to the buses at the stop. Click or drag a passenger to send them into a bus of the same color, pairing the people in line with the appropriate buses.

pages.title: Dino Egg Shooter
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Dino Egg Shooter is an aiming puzzle set in a prehistoric world. Fire colorful dinosaur eggs to clear the board, working through formations that become more difficult across one hundred levels. Limited shots add a constraint to the board-clearing challenges.

pages.title: Stick Fight The Chaos
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description:
Stick Fight The Chaos puts stickmen into battles with weapons falling from above. Catch the weapons, keep your fighter balanced, and defeat the opponents as you progress through the levels. Play alone or bring a friend into the fighting.

Victories earn money to buy new weapons and special powers. Stronger opponents appear with each new level.

pages.title: Halloween Store Sort
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Halloween Store Sort is a timed shelf puzzle featuring spooky toys and decorations. Drag items between shelves until three identical objects sit together, clearing that set and allowing the shelves above to slide downward.

Clearing a whole stack shifts neighboring shelves, revealing more items to sort. Collect everything before the timer expires, and use Shuffle when you need help with the arrangement. Mouse or touchpad input moves the objects.

pages.title: Mini Grand Theft City
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Mini Grand Theft City combines street crime with constructing buildings in a small city. Walk or run through the streets, attack passers-by, and enter homes or businesses to take furniture. Sell the stolen furniture to make money for building. Use the mouse or touchscreen to play.

pages.title: Black Friday Shopping Mania
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Black Friday Shopping Mania takes Kendall Jenner on a mall trip that combines outfit selection with hidden-object shopping. Use the mouse to choose available dress-up items and search the shop shelves for objects shown on the target list. Finding an item unlocks it for the wardrobe. The shopping sections run against a timer, so scan the shelves and collect the matching finds before time runs out.

pages.title: Bewildered Lover
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Bewildered Lover follows an emoji searching for an imprisoned partner. Guide the character along the roads, pass the obstacles, and collect hearts to help with the rescue. The hearts you gather also make the waiting lover happier. Use the mouse or touchscreen to guide the character toward a reunion.

pages.title: Highway Cars Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Highway Cars Traffic Racer puts you on a highway with other vehicles as you try to build your score and cover more distance. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys and press F to activate nitro. The driving display tracks distance, score, and high-speed performance during the run.

pages.title: L.O.L. Surprise! O.M.G.™ Style Studio
pages.creator: MGA
pages.description:
L.O.L. Surprise! O.M.G.™ Style Studio lets you dress Royal Bee, Neon Licious, Lady Diva, Swag, and eighteen other dolls. Follow style missions to earn likes, or create your own combination from the available clothes and show it in a photoshoot.

Check the in-game phone for a mission's required items, buy outfits with coins, and complete the look to earn more coins. Use the mouse or touchscreen, and save the dolls' finished looks to your device.

pages.title: Stickman Troll- Thief Puzzle
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Stickman Troll- Thief Puzzle turns a long, stretching arm into the tool for a series of theft puzzles. Guide the troll's hand toward items such as snacks or a car, working around obstacles and avoiding capture.

pages.title: Flower Sorting
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Flower Sorting challenges you to group matching flowers in columns. Take a flower from a column and move it into an empty column or onto a column whose top flower matches it.

Use the mouse or touchpad to make those moves, rearranging the flowers until matching types are grouped together.

pages.title: Doc Darling Bone Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description:
Doc Darling Bone Surgery follows a girl who has fallen from her scooter and needs help with injuries and broken bones. Play the doctor and work through the treatment stages to help her get back on her feet.

Completing every stage unlocks dress-up mode, where you can give the girl a makeover. Use the mouse to interact with the game.

pages.title: Couple Rich Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Couple Rich Rush is a running game about helping a couple build their savings together. Pass money between the two characters and use the money-boosting doors along the course to increase their total.

Avoid spending away those earnings: the money you preserve can furnish and decorate the house. Use sliding input to play through the run.

pages.title: Tailed Monsters — Puzzle
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Tailed Monsters — Puzzle asks you to arrange snake-like monsters in their required positions. Pull a monster by its head or tail to move it around the field, using your finger or mouse cursor to work each creature into the right place.

pages.title: Bouncy king
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Bouncy king is a ball-routing puzzle with thirty levels. Arrange wood and other objects so the ball can reach its hole, then hold to build its launch speed and release.

pages.title: Ellie And Ben Insta Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Ellie And Ben Insta Fashion is a dress-up game about choosing Instagram looks for Ellie and her boyfriend Ben. Browse their wardrobes, pick clothing to suit their moods, and add accessories to complete the outfits. Use the left mouse button to make your selections.

pages.title: Gurido
pages.creator: Okashi Games
pages.description:
Gurido is a color-matching block puzzle on a ten-by-ten grid. Drag the irregular colored figure shown above the board into an empty area, building connected groups of at least five cells of one color to clear them.

Large groups and some luck can bring powerful items that clear more cells. Consider both the shape's available space and the colors it will join when choosing a placement.

pages.title: Noob Flip
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Noob Flip is a one-button backflip challenge featuring a pixelated Noob. Use the mouse or touchscreen to attempt a controlled backflip and work through the levels.

pages.title: Gangs Idle City
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description:
Gangs Idle City puts you in control of a gangster trying to earn money and expand his surroundings. Improve the tools you use step by step as the levels develop and you work toward controlling more of the city.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space, and press Shift to dash.

pages.title: Army Driver
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description:
Army Driver is a driving game with thirty levels and an army truck to customize. Use the garage to buy more vehicles and improve the ones you have.

A and D or the left and right arrows control the vehicle. Press W or the Up arrow to jump as you work through the driving courses.

pages.title: Flying Orange
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description:
Flying Orange is a jetpack platformer about helping a small orange escape danger in space. Pick up fuel as you travel and keep clear of the traps and enemies along the route.

Use the Left and Right arrows to move, Z to jump, and X to activate the jetpack. The game's menu also lets you change the control configuration.

pages.title: Bike Racing 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Bike Racing 3 is an endless hill-climbing game about taking a motorcycle as far as possible while keeping the rider upright. Choose a vehicle suited to the terrain: a scooter for rolling hills, a cross-bike for dunes, or a heavy classic bike for icy conditions.

Gather coins, reach checkpoints, and perform stunts for additional money. Spend those earnings on more bikes and tracks, or improve the fuel tank, engine, and tires to extend a run. A ghost representing your high score gives you a target to beat as you continue across the hills and obstacles.

pages.title: Squid Challenge
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay
pages.description: Squid Challenge is a survival game whose opening trial uses red and green lights. Move while the signal is green and stop when it turns red, timing your actions around the changing cue. Use the mouse or a finger for the game's movement, jumping, and other actions.

pages.title: Stickman Training Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stickman Training Hero puts a superhero through movement and combat training. Use WASD to move, the right mouse button to aim, and Space to hit. The left button handles jumping, flying, and shooting actions.

On a touchscreen, use the on-screen controls to perform the training actions and guide the stickman.

pages.title: Pop It Fidget
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Pop It Fidget presents twenty virtual popping-toy levels. Tap every dot on the displayed toy to complete each layout.

pages.title: Fruit Swipe Mania
pages.creator: Bizogames.com
pages.description:
Fruit Swipe Mania is a matching puzzle where you swap fruit to form groups of at least three identical pieces. A line of four creates a rocket, while five in a row produces a special cake.

Meet the level's collection target before your moves run out. Booster items provide help with difficult situations, and completing levels opens further challenges.

pages.title: Stickman Team Force 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stickman Team Force 2 sends Jacky, Jim, and Joe on a mission through Egypt's deserts. Guide the team against monsters awakened by a spell, moving the characters into action and destroying the enemies threatening the world.

Move with WASD, attack with Z, and use X or Space for a special action. C changes the active character. Touchscreen players use the on-screen buttons to control the team.

pages.title: Philatelic Escape Fauna Album 2
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description:
Philatelic Escape Fauna Album 2 is a point-and-click stamp hunt inside an apartment. Get through the front door, explore the room, and collect items that help solve its puzzles. Your goal is to find ten postage stamps.

Search shelves and other corners for clues, keys, and useful objects. Numeric and letter codes block parts of the search, so connect the clues you discover with the puzzles that need them.

pages.title: Love Tester Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Love Tester Deluxe turns a pair of names into several compatibility scores. Enter both names and press Love Test to display the game's love percentage, then use the other buttons to see Chemistry, Friendship, Passion, and Compatibility results.

The Final Results button gathers the scores into an overview, letting you compare the different categories for that name pairing.

pages.title: Impostor Rescue
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Impostor Rescue is a pin-pulling puzzle set in space. Work out which pins to release as you rescue the hero, overcome the impostors, and collect the treasures.

pages.title: Dangerous Danny
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Dangerous Danny follows a diver trying to set a new depth record. Guide Danny farther into the ocean, collecting coins while avoiding sea creatures, mines, cliffs, and sharks.

Keep his oxygen and health replenished during the descent. Progress depends on getting deeper while managing those supplies and staying clear of the hazards in the water.

pages.title: Cute Turtle Jigsaw Puzzles
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cute Turtle Jigsaw Puzzles offers a collection of turtle pictures to rebuild. Fit the separate jigsaw pieces together until the chosen picture is complete. Use the mouse or tap the screen to work through the turtle-themed puzzles.

pages.title: Fairy Pony Caring Adventure
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Fairy Pony Caring Adventure combines a horse farm with caring and riding activities. Look after the fairy princess's unicorns, colts, and ponies, then try the farm's riding challenges and hair-salon activities.

Use the mouse or tap the screen to interact with the animals and work through the different parts of the pony-care adventure.

pages.title: Monster Run Adventure
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Monster Run Adventure sends Riki, a small monster trapped in a mine, on a climb back to the surface. Jump from one wall to the other to avoid the obstacles and mechanical traps in his path.

The climb keeps getting faster, giving you less time to react. Use the mouse or tap the screen to control Riki as you work toward escaping the mine.

pages.title: Buca
pages.creator: GameBake Ltd
pages.description: Buca is a puck-aiming puzzle with a hole as the target. Press the screen, hold, and pull back to fling the puck toward the opening. Work through the level layouts by judging how to direct each attempt into the hole.

pages.title: Cookie Tap
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Cookie Tap is an idle baking game where tapping produces cookies. Improve your tapping abilities to increase your earnings, then hire grandmas to help with the baking. Farms, bakeries, and factories provide more ways to generate cookies.

The building purchases turn some of the work into passive production. If you leave the game for a while, it credits cookies for that time when you return, connecting your purchases with earnings between visits.

pages.title: Chained Tractor Towing Simulator
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description:
Chained Tractor Towing Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a heavy tractor connected by a chain to another tractor. Drive the linked vehicles carefully, keeping the connection in mind as you steer.

Use the keyboard arrows to control the tractor.

pages.title: Chaki Water Hop
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Chaki Water Hop is a platform-jumping challenge over water. Choose whether to leap across one platform or two, bringing Chaki safely from landing to landing without slipping into the water. Use the mouse to play and watch the gaps before choosing the distance of each jump.

pages.title: ABC Jump
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
ABC Jump combines platform jumping with alphabet practice. Guide the character between lettered clouds while the game presents letters in order, pairing their shapes with their sounds.

Use the mouse or tap the screen to play, following the alphabet as the jumping activity continues.

pages.title: Black Forest Cake
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Black Forest Cake is a baking game centered on a layered chocolate cake. Prepare the cake with whipped cream and cherries between the layers, then finish it with more cream, maraschino cherries, and chocolate shavings. Follow the game's instructions as you put together and decorate the dessert.

pages.title: Animals Fall
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Animals Fall asks you to guide a parachuting animal safely through the sky. Move away from rocks, then watch for planes entering from the sides as the descent continues. The goal is to land without losing a life. Use the mouse to control the animal and find a safe path downward.

pages.title: Stickman Team Force
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stickman Team Force sends a special team against a high-tech organization trying to take over the world's streets. Fight to stop the threat while switching between the available heroes.

Press Z or click to shoot, C to change hero, and Space to use a special attack. Hero changes and weapon fire are your tools for taking on the organization.

pages.title: Adam and Eve: Snow
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Adam and Eve: Snow gives Adam a Christmas errand: bring Eve a Christmas tree. Work through the holiday-themed levels by clicking objects in the scene and solving the problems that block his journey. Help Adam complete the puzzles so he can deliver the tree.

pages.title: Air Fighter
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Air Fighter is an aerial combat game about taking down enemy aircraft. Move your plane through the incoming fighters and use its unlimited supply of bullets against them. Mouse controls are available, while touch and swipe input also let you guide the aircraft on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Combat Rescue Officer
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Combat Rescue Officer is a first-person shooter about fighting undead enemies and staying alive. Move through the combat setting with WASD or the arrow keys, then use the mouse to aim and fire.

G throws a grenade, H uses a medical kit, and V performs a melee attack. You can also crouch with Control, switch weapons with the mouse wheel or number keys 1 through 3, and turn on a flashlight with L. These actions give you several combat and movement tools for confronting the enemies.

pages.title: BMW X6 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
BMW X6 Puzzle offers six pictures of the BMW X6 to reconstruct as jigsaws. Choose an image and fit its pieces into place using the mouse.

Each picture has four layouts: 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Choose a piece count to set the size of the assembly task for the car picture you want to solve.

pages.title: Princess Balloon Festival
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Balloon Festival helps Mia, Emma, and Bella get ready for a balloon festival. Choose balloon-themed outfits and accessories for the three girls, putting together their looks for the event. Use the mouse to make the clothing and accessory selections.

pages.title: Crazy Stack
pages.creator: Tasty Cherry
pages.description: Crazy Stack is a timing game about building a tower of blocks. Tap at the right moment to add to the stack and try to make it as high as possible while working toward a better score.

pages.title: Princesses Sunflower Delight
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princesses Sunflower Delight is a dress-up game for Bella, Ella, and Mia. Choose sunflower-themed dresses and suitable accessories for the three girls, using the mouse to combine the clothing and finish each character's look.

pages.title: Neon Hockey
pages.creator: Gamesdev
pages.description: Neon Hockey challenges you to defend your goal and send the puck into your opponent's. Drag the stick with the mouse or a touch gesture to hit the puck, positioning it for both defensive stops and shots toward the other goal.

pages.title: Oil Tanker Truck Drive
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Oil Tanker Truck Drive is a level-based driving game with several truck models. Guide your truck to the finish to complete each level. Use WASD to drive, press C to change the camera, and use Tab to pause.

pages.title: Air Combat Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Air Combat Puzzle is a jigsaw collection with six air-combat pictures to reconstruct. Select an image, then fit its pieces together using mouse or touch controls.

Each picture has four layouts: 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Choose a smaller piece count for fewer fragments or a larger one for a more detailed assembly task.

pages.title: Butterfly Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Butterfly Puzzle Challenge is a jigsaw game with easy, medium, and hard settings for each picture. Rebuild the selected image by fitting its pieces together.

There is no time limit, so you can study the fragments at your own pace. Use the mouse or tap to play.

pages.title: Happy Cupcaker
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Happy Cupcaker lets you design a cupcake of your own, making the dessert's look the main creative task.

pages.title: Annie Wedding Shopping
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Annie Wedding Shopping asks you to put together Annie's bridal outfit. Choose from different wedding dresses and accessories, coordinating the items for her wedding look. Use the mouse to make your selections.

pages.title: Cross Road Exit
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Cross Road Exit is a parking puzzle where cars, buses, and trailers block your vehicle's way out. Move the surrounding traffic to open a route and get your vehicle out of the crowded lot. The game offers one hundred levels that become more difficult as you progress.

pages.title: Endless Runner 3d
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description:
Endless Runner 3d sends you running through subway routes while collecting coins to unlock more levels. Build your score as you continue through the 3D running challenge.

The left and right arrows move sideways, Up jumps, and Space activates the hoverboard, giving you movement options during the run.

pages.title: EG Alien Defense
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Alien Defense is a battle against an alien invasion across twenty levels. Help the heroes eliminate the attackers and collect coins for improvements.

Upgrade weapons and heroic combat abilities as you progress. You can also unlock an assistant to fight alongside the heroes and improve that helper's strength.

pages.title: Superspin.io
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: Superspin.io puts spinners in competition. Increase your spinning speed, grow larger, and knock rival players.

pages.title: Burning Man Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Burning Man Hairstyles is a festival-preparation game about creating a hairstyle for a girl attending Burning Man. Choose a styling route and work through its hair activities, then put together clothing and accessories to finish her look. Use mouse or touch input for the styling and dress-up choices.

pages.title: Math Test 2
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Math Test 2 is a timed arithmetic game covering multiplication, addition, and subtraction. Answer as many questions as you can during a sixty-second round, working out each result quickly to increase your points total.

pages.title: Abyssal Fish
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Abyssal Fish puts a hungry deep-sea fish in dark water where the obstacles are difficult to see. Guide it toward its next meal, using the light from bright fish to learn the route. Remember where the dangers are as you continue through the darkness.

pages.title: Snake and Ladder
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Snake and Ladder is a board game about reaching the top of a numbered grid. Roll the die and move your piece from the starting square toward the finish. Ladders help you climb, while snakes send you back. The game supports two or more players, with the die rolls determining how far each piece travels.

pages.title: Word Finder Board Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Word Finder Board Game gives you two minutes to make words from its letters. Draw a line through letters to build each word, then look for another combination while there is time left.

pages.title: Mini Putt Gem Garden
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Mini Putt Gem Garden combines putting with collecting gems. Guide the golf ball through the course, avoid its hazards, and gather the gems along the way. Try to get the ball into the hole in a single stroke while working through the garden's obstacles.

pages.title: Buggy Rally
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Buggy Rally is a driving game with a direct objective: take the buggy to the finish line. Guide the vehicle along its route and work toward reaching the end.

pages.title: Spongebob Crossdress
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Spongebob Crossdress helps SpongeSue prepare to meet her new neighbors in Bikini Bottom. Begin by choosing her eye shape, eyebrows, nose, and smile, then put together a hairstyle by selecting the bangs, back, and color.

Dress SpongeSue in a two-piece outfit or a dress, and finish with accessories. Use mouse or touch input to work through the face, hair, and wardrobe choices before her meeting with SpongeBob.

pages.title: Bubble World H5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bubble World H5 is a Middle-Eastern-themed bubble shooter with magic gemstone bubbles. Use the mouse to aim your shots and work through the level's bubble puzzle. Each stage limits the moves you can make, so choose where to send a bubble before using another move.

pages.title: Monster Girl Real Makeover
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description:
Monster Girl Real Makeover combines hair styling, makeup, and clothes for a monster-themed salon visit. Curl, straighten, cut, and color the character's hair, then use the available makeup items to change her look.

Choose an outfit to go with the hairstyle and cosmetics, putting together the monster girl's makeover through the salon's different styling activities.

pages.title: Barbie Becomes An Actress
pages.creator: Bitent Media
pages.description: Barbie Becomes An Actress is a makeover game about preparing Barbie for an audition. Choose a dress and simple makeup to put together her audition look. Browse her closet or buy new clothing items, mixing the pieces to create the outfit she will wear as she pursues her acting plans.

pages.title: Cinderella Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Cinderella Pregnant Check Up takes Cinderella to a doctor before her baby arrives. Work through the game's examination activities, including checking her temperature and pulse and using the ultrasound machine to view the baby.

The visit ends with music and belly tattoos for the princess. Tap the game's items to move through the visit and its final activities.

pages.title: Princess Pijama Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Pijama Party is a dress-up game about getting three princesses ready for a pajama party at home. Choose from the available outfits and find pajamas for each of them, putting together their looks for the gathering.
